name: C#
criteria: Statically typed .NET with LINQ pipelines, records, switch-expression pattern matching, tuples as dictionary keys, PriorityQueue<T,P>, spans and BigInteger; fast JIT-compiled loops for simulation, grids and graph search.
build: mkdir -p .build && { [ -e .build/ok ] && [ -z "$(find . -maxdepth 1 -name '*.cs*' -newer .build/ok)" ] || { touch .build/new && dotnet build -c Release -o .build/out --nologo -v q -clp:NoSummary && mv .build/new .build/ok; }; }
